notes: Schema for uat B, which works in linga-text.cjs, recertify.cjs and env.md. JUDGE: judgeSchema(priorIds, doneIds) adds `done` only when ctx.journey (the journey file TEXT) has a '## Definition of done' section: {type:'array', minItems=maxItems=n, items:{id enum ['D1'..'Dn'], result enum ['pass','fail','n-a'], evidence maxLength 500}}. 'done' is in schema.required. judgeAccept(ids, doneIds) drops 'prior' and 'done' from required and sets both properties to {}. judgeRequest adds `accept` when either is present. The payload gains done:[{id, check}] after `journey`. The system prompt gains doneRule when D checks exist. A ctx.journey that is just a journey id ('J3', as in uat-recertify-test) yields no done. RECORDS (per-Character <c>.json journeys[]), set by the new linga-text.cjs judgeRecord(record, ctx, call), which the child now calls in place of judgeJourney: doneAsked ['D1'..] (the ids asked), judge (unchanged, judge.verdict still inside, plus judge.done), verdict, verdictWhy [{kind: ended|judge|breach|criterion|done|gate, id, level: not-reached|fail|conditional, text, check?}], verdictNotes [strings, e.g. 'no definition-of-done rows'], judgeVerdict. Committed runs have none of these fields. Every reader recomputes with verdict.cjs verdictOf(record, contextOf(character, journeyId)), which is pure and reads uat/characters and uat/journeys. synthesize() and renderRecertify() already do this, so do not trust a stored `verdict` on old files. verdict.cjs exports doneChecks, gatesOf, contextOf, doneStatuses, verdictOf, verdictCell and RESULTS. report.md scorecard: the Verdict cell is verdictCell(v) and a new Judge column follows it (12 columns). Above the table sits the plain line 'judge verdicts no recorded check explains: N of M'. recertify.cjs renderRecertify Regressed and the masked rows compare code verdicts, skip not-reached on either side, and cite the reasons that turned; a regressed row with no finding reads '(no finding filed)'. instrumentOf() now hashes verdict.cjs too. Journey sim blocks gained `gates`. The desk working tree held the uncommitted session and pairing work of the tv-surface sibling, and npm test was exit 0 with it present.
